rule: GREEN only: public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, ODbL, or explicit commercial-use statement; free forever; no Space-Track / 18 SDS / USSF catalogue (TLE/GP) data, including mirrors.

sources.name: IGS multi-GNSS merged broadcast ephemerides (RINEX 3 nav, BRDC00WRD_S / BRDC00IGS_R)
sources.operator: Each operator's own navigation message (US Space Force GPS, Roscosmos GLONASS, EU Galileo, CSNO BeiDou, Japan QZSS, ISRO NavIC, SBAS operators), recorded by the IGS station network and merged by IGS/BKG
sources.satellites: 152 navigation satellites (GPS 32, GLONASS 26, Galileo 30, BeiDou 38, QZSS 6, NavIC 5, SBAS 15)
sources.licence: IGS Data and Product Disclaimer and Terms of Use (5 Aug 2020): data and products 'provided openly for the benefit of all scientific, educational, and commercial users', 'available for use without restriction', 'free of cost or obligation'; users must cite and attribute IGS and its contributing organisations
sources.notes: Not a catalogue product: these are the orbits the satellites broadcast themselves, recorded by independent IGS stations. The BKG mirror page shows no separate licence; the IGS terms cover IGS data centres.

sources.name: IGS / MGEX precise orbits (SP3)
sources.access: CDDIS (Earthdata login) or BKG product mirror
sources.licence: same IGS terms (open, including commercial use)
sources.notes: Delivered 1-14 days late; broadcast orbits give a current window.

sources.name: ILRS CPF laser-ranging predictions (EDC DGFI-TUM, CDDIS)
sources.operator: Mission operators and ILRS prediction centres
sources.satellites: about 100 SLR targets from many countries (LAGEOS, Jason, Sentinel, ICESat-2, HY-2, Ajisai, LARES ...)
sources.licence: No explicit licence or commercial-use statement found on the EDC or ILRS data pages (checked 2026-11-27)
sources.verdict: EXCLUDED (licence not verified; some predictions may be TLE-seeded)
sources.notes: Best candidate for adding LEO science satellites if ILRS/EDC publish an explicit open licence.

sources.name: Space-Track.org GP/TLE catalogue
sources.licence: User agreement forbids transfer to other entities without prior approval (10 USC 2274)

sources.name: CelesTrak, SatNOGS DB, N2YO, Heavens-Above and other TLE mirrors
sources.licence: Data originates at Space-Track even when labelled CC BY-SA

sources.name: AMSAT Keplerian elements
sources.licence: Elements are derived from Space-Track TLEs

sources.name: ESA/Copernicus Sentinel precise orbit (POD) files
sources.licence: The Copernicus open licence is green, but access is through Copernicus Data Space with an account, and the files cover past orbits only
sources.verdict: NOT USED (needs an account; not checked further within the time cap)

sources.name: NASA ISS OEM trajectory
sources.verdict: GREEN, not added (sky.js already draws the ISS from NASA SSC)
